request.title: Product Milestone 9 — Production Provider Sandbox Evaluation and Pilot Readiness
request.objective: Validate production-capable provider integrations safely before enabling them for paying users.

tasks.title: Define OpenAI-compatible LLM evaluation contract
acceptance_criteria: Contract covers model configuration, structured response validation, privacy-safe prompts and credential redaction.

tasks.title: Design LLM reliability and measurement protocol
acceptance_criteria: Protocol measures latency, tokens, usage, estimated cost, timeouts, bounded retry and fallback behavior.

tasks.title: Evaluate LLM evidence without selecting a provider
acceptance_criteria: Comparable evidence is recorded for approved candidates; no provider is selected without human approval.

tasks.title: Define Indian-English STT corpus and consent protocol
acceptance_criteria: Corpus plan covers Indian English and Telugu-accented English with explicit consent and no unrestricted customer audio.

tasks.title: Design STT quality, limit and latency evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Matrix covers formats, duration, size, latency, confidence, transcription quality, errors and bounded retries.

tasks.title: Approve raw-audio handling protocol
acceptance_criteria: Retention, deletion, access and audit controls are approved before any sandbox audio evaluation.

tasks.title: Define Indian-English TTS voice evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation is limited to one female and one male Indian-English voice candidate per provider.

tasks.title: Measure TTS quality and playback behavior
acceptance_criteria: Evidence covers clarity, naturalness, rate, latency, formats, cancellation and fallback voice behavior.

tasks.title: Prepare voice decision evidence
acceptance_criteria: Male and female voice placeholders remain unresolved until comparative evidence passes human review.

tasks.title: Specify TTS timing and viseme boundary
acceptance_criteria: Provider timing and provider-neutral viseme events map to the existing avatar state machine.

tasks.title: Design approximate lip-sync fallback
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic approximate synchronization works when provider timing is unavailable and makes no photorealism claim.

tasks.title: Define avatar cancellation and recovery tests
acceptance_criteria: Listening, thinking and speaking transitions recover safely after cancellation, timeout or provider failure.

tasks.title: Design isolated non-production provider sandbox
acceptance_criteria: Only test accounts, bounded credentials and non-production endpoints are permitted.

tasks.title: Define usage, cost and access ceilings
acceptance_criteria: Per-user limits, monthly ceiling, alerts and automatic stop controls prevent unrestricted access or production billing activation.

tasks.title: Specify health, circuit-breaker and audit controls
acceptance_criteria: Health checks, circuit breaker, privacy-safe audit logs and credential redaction are testable before provider calls.

tasks.title: Define internal pilot cohort and notices
acceptance_criteria: Named internal cohort receives consent, privacy and supported-use notices before access.

tasks.title: Define browser, microphone, latency and quality gates
acceptance_criteria: Supported browsers, microphone compatibility, response latency and transcription quality thresholds are explicit decisions.

tasks.title: Define pilot fallback and incident process
acceptance_criteria: Provider failure falls back to text and has an owner, incident path and support runbook.

tasks.title: Build estimated sandbox cost model
acceptance_criteria: Model separates LLM tokens, STT minutes, TTS characters, avatar timing, fixed fees and contingency without inventing prices.

tasks.title: Collect required decision evidence
acceptance_criteria: All ten decision placeholders contain comparable evidence, source date and reviewer-ready rationale.

tasks.title: Complete provider evaluation matrix
acceptance_criteria: Every candidate is scored using the same verified criteria; missing evidence is marked unknown, never inferred.

tasks.title: Run privacy, security and commercial review
acceptance_criteria: Review explicitly approves or rejects retention, credentials, budget, access and incident controls.

tasks.title: Complete pilot go/no-go checklist
acceptance_criteria: All mandatory checklist items have evidence and an accountable reviewer; unknowns force NO_GO.

tasks.title: Record human milestone decision
acceptance_criteria: Named human records GO, NO_GO or REQUEST_CHANGES; planning never authorizes implementation automatically.

provider_evaluation_matrix.selection_rule: No selection until comparable evidence is complete and human-approved.

estimated_sandbox_cost_model.formula: LLM input tokens + LLM output tokens + STT audio minutes + TTS characters + optional timing fees + fixed sandbox fees + contingency

risks.mitigation: Representative consented corpus and human scoring.
Measure end-to-end percentiles and require text fallback.
Hard ceilings, per-user limits, alerts and automatic stop.
Secret isolation, redaction tests and privacy-safe persistence.
Human-approved retention and verified deletion protocol.
Evaluate only through provider-neutral boundaries and portable contracts.
Label approximate fallback and exclude photorealistic/video avatars.
Publish tested support matrix and preflight compatibility checks.
Health checks, circuit breaker, cancellation and text fallback.
Named owners, support process and NO_GO gate.

go_no_go_checklist: credentials cannot enter logs or persistence
sandbox and user cost ceilings enforced
male and female Indian-English voices approved
